task_statement: Review and correct a supplied candidate patch for hasSearchParameters. The candidate handles null by returning false but also changes string handling so '0' returns false and deletes the URLSearchParams deletion test. Keep corrections bounded to source/utils/options.ts and the relevant test file, with at most two review rounds.
